## About Tanvir Hossain

Tanvir Hossain is a trader and gamer originally from Madaripur, Bangladesh, currently living in Italy.

He is known online as TANVIR TRADER and @T4nviRhossain.

His interests and experience include Quotex trading, Forex trading, price action analysis, risk management, and competitive Garena Free Fire gaming.
